resources.string: Clean your library like browsing a feed
Photos and videos have separate paths: swipe photo cards, or move through videos in a short-video flow. Review the rules, then grant photo access.
Photos: swipe left or right to keep, up or down to favorite or delete
Videos: swipe up or down to switch, left or right to scrub
Items marked for deletion go to a review area first

Core actions live here: keep, reshuffle, photo filters, date filters, and the remaining count. Filters expand when tapped.
Tap the image to open it. Clear left or right swipes keep it; clear vertical swipes favorite or mark it for deletion. Diagonal drags avoid destructive actions.
Capture time, folder, type, size, and remaining count are shown here. Tap the info bar to inspect the photo.
Tap the album button to expand target folders. Keep and favorite actions can archive automatically based on Settings.
Long-press the image or tap here to play motion

Use a relative album path such as Pictures/Kanleme/Favorites/. The system may ask for photo write access.
Browse synced videos by capture time and open them in the system player.
Browse synced photos by capture time and swipe left or right after opening.
Sync the local media library first. With partial Android 14 access, only authorized photos appear here.
Sync the local media library first. Only videos you have authorized appear here.
Detect duplicates, bursts, screenshots, and blurry photos in the background. Return later to view progress
Detection continues in the background. Return home or lock the screen and come back to resume progress.
The scan reads your current library, calculates perceptual hashes and sharpness scores, and clusters bursts and screenshots into groups you can clean in batches.
Leaving the page does not interrupt detection. Reopen it to see the same progress.

Cleaning continues without rounds. An empty queue usually means this filter, excluded folders, or photo access has no remaining videos.
Progress, pending deletes, and reshuffle stay on the first row, so portrait tablets keep clear of the left dock.
Tap the video to play or pause. Swipe left or right to switch immersive viewing and controls. Only the current page creates a player.
Play and pause stay in the side rail. Keep, favorite, delete, and share share one column so the info area stays clear.

Keepix organizes your full photo library, so it needs access to photos and videos. Scanning stays on this device and media files are never uploaded.

The timeline and cleaning flow only show photos and videos Android allows Keepix to access. To clean the full library, grant access again and choose all photos and videos.
